producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 87 BPM, 4/4, B-flat minor. A slow, heavy, swinging march. Tough on the outside and warm inside.

VOICE: A female lead with a cool, slightly nasal, island-accented tone and very little vibrato. Low and steady in the verses, stronger and higher in the chorus, with the last word of the hook stretched into repeated syllables. A male rapper with a calm, authoritative voice delivers the introduction.

INSTRUMENTS: A loud, crashing hi-hat and drum loop that sounds like a rock drummer sampled and looped. A thick, distorted synth bass. A string section that grows through the song. Heavy electric guitars that arrive in the bridge and final chorus. A dark piano under the verses. A synth pad.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the drum loop and the rap. 0:22 Verse 1. 0:44 Pre-chorus. 0:55 Chorus 1 with the stretched syllables. 1:28 Verse 2. 1:50 Pre-chorus. 2:01 Chorus 2. 2:34 Bridge, the beat thins and a guitar enters. 2:56 Final chorus with guitars and ad-libs. 3:29 Outro, the loop alone, a key turning in a lock, and one spoken line at 3:45.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2000s pop-R&B with rock weight: big drums, wide strings, a dry and very present lead vocal, deep sub.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The stretched syllables at the end of the first chorus.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The pledge is domestic and middle-aged: a creaking stair, a flowerpot, a kettle. It is sung by someone who has already been through a few storms with the other person.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Cool reassurance, loyalty, then an open door.
